about: Paging scenarios: steps on the table and the page requests each causes, in order. See README.md for the steps and the events.

steps.why: Only the visible page starts while it isn't loaded.
Resting: prefetch 2 each side (none above page 0).
Rows 1000..1028 span pages 0-1; moving down, prefetch is 4 ahead (2-5); 3 reads in flight at most.
Pages 4 and 5 are still in flight, and every wanted page is loaded or loading.
Rows 3000..3028 are page 2: wanted 2, then 3,1,4,0,5,6; 4 and 5 are in flight, so one more read.
249 ms since the last move: still leaning ahead.
Rested 250 ms: prefetch evens out to 2 each side (0-4), so 5 and 6 are cancelled.
The cancelled reads answer and free their places; nothing more is wanted.
floor(0.9 x rows) is row 1410770, on page 1377. Pages 1 and 2 are stale and cancelled, but they hold their places until they answer: one place left, for the visible page.
A place is free, but no prefetch starts while the visible page loads.
Visible page in: prefetch, 2 places (page 2 still draining). Moving down: 1378, 1376, 1379, 1375, 1380, 1381.
Rested: 1375-1379 wanted, and every read in flight is among them.
A drag loads nothing until the pointer rests 80 ms. Top = 0.25 x (rows - viewport_rows).
Moved again: the 80 ms start over.
Rested 80 ms at rows 783747..783776 (page 765): only the visible page, which isn't loaded.
Page 765 isn't cancelled yet: nothing is decided until the pointer rests or lets go.
Letting go loads at once: page 1148; 765 is stale.
Still leaning ahead (the last move was under 250 ms ago).
Rested: 1146-1150 wanted, all loaded; loaded pages are never cancelled.
A press on the track jumps the thumb there and starts a drag.
The release comes before the 80 ms: it loads at once.
The last page, 1530, is short: rows 1566720..1567523.
Nothing below the last page; 2 behind.
Rows 1566495..1566523 are page 1529. Moving up: 4 ahead above (1528-1525), 2 behind below (1530).
Rested: 2 each side, 1527-1530.
A failed visible page shows its error and doesn't hold prefetch back.
A failure isn't retried while it stays in view.
Scrolled away: the failure is forgotten.
Back: the failed page is read again.
16 MiB pages: four fit in 64 MiB.
Each page past the budget evicts the least recently used page that isn't wanted; wanted pages stay, over budget or not.
Pages 0-2 were evicted.
